name: wfm-controlm
description: Workforce Management Job Scheduling & Orchestration Platform

scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:deploy: cd backend && node node_modules/prisma/build/index.js migrate deploy
scripts.db:bootstrap:clients: cd backend && node scripts/apply-sql.js ../database/clients-dml.sql && node scripts/apply-sql.js ../database/fix-client-datetimes.sql
scripts.db:bootstrap: npm run db:bootstrap:ddl && npm run db:bootstrap:dml && npm run db:bootstrap:clients
scripts.db:seed: cd backend && npx prisma db seed
scripts.docker:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml -f docker-compose.mailpit.yml -f docker-compose.smoke.override.yml up -d --build
